clips.title: The story
paras: In Goldshire, Keryn Sylvius sends new rogues toward SI: 7. A sealed package carried to Stormwind City brings them before Master Mathias Shaw, who leads the crown's covert intelligence network.

At the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, rogue trainer Keryn Sylvius wastes no time praising newcomers. She thinks fresh initiates look more like cheese delivery hands than covert agents, yet gives them a sealed delivery for the capital. The trip tests their reliability as couriers and quietly vets scouts for wider service to the realm.

SI: 7 works from the southeastern corner of Old Town in Stormwind City. The worn district holds the command center of Stormwind Intelligence, Section 7, where Master Mathias Shaw oversees the kingdom's covert operations. Shaw receives the package with dry skepticism and judges whether the traveler has the grit for real espionage.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The badge? Oh, it's nothing, fish - nothing you could handle anyhow. By the looks of you, I'd say Mathias is likely to mistake you for the cheese delivery kid instead of a proper rogue. Regardless, I've been assigned a job and I've made a promise to deliver on that job.
Speaking of which, deliver this package to Mathias and he may give you a small task or two.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You found me - and by looking at you, I'd say the run and subsequent search may have been a great strain on your system, both mentally and physically.
Would you like Renzik to show you the way to an inn or are you ready for some work?

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
